pattern: save a durable decision to workstream memory
experience: A thread in a workstream is told a decision that other threads on the same effort must follow. The agent records it with workstream_memory_remember instead of leaving it only in this conversation.
rule: workstream_memory_remember: Save one entry to this thread's workstream memory, for other threads on the same effort to read.
prompt: Decision for everyone working on the checkout rewrite: we keep the v1 payments endpoint alive until 1 March because the mobile app still calls it. Make sure the other threads in this workstream know. No code changes needed right now.

pattern: read workstream memory when asked what the effort has decided
experience: Asked what the other threads on the effort have already decided, the agent reads workstream memory instead of guessing or searching the repository.
rule: workstream_memory_read: Read the shared memory of this thread's workstream.

entries.text: Keep the v1 payments endpoint alive until 1 March; the mobile app still calls it.
Port the refund flow to the new service.

prompt: Before I start: what have the other threads in this workstream already decided or left open? Check the workstream memory.

pattern: ordinary task: no memory write for routine progress
experience: A routine question with nothing durable in it. The agent answers and does not write a workstream memory entry for it.
rule: workstream_memory_remember: not for progress notes or secrets.
prompt: What does `git status --short` print for a renamed file? Just explain, don't run anything.
